name: The Horde Needs More Lean Wolf Steaks!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs More Lean Wolf Steaks!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: As you can see, adventurer, we still need to pack away more food for the soldiers. I don't know if you've ever been in a war before, but once you get past the initial shock of the battlefield, you can get pretty hungry. You did a good job last time, so I expect that you'll do as well, if not a little quicker, in getting me another stack of those lean wolf steaks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Smells like you, or someone you know, are quite the cook, friend. Those lean wolf steaks are making my mouth water; I suppose a few going missing won't be noticed. Anyway, good work. I'll make sure someone packs them away right so that they don't spoil too much.
If you come across more, you know where to find me.
